jobs.title: Lead Core Banking Switzerland
jobs.description:
We are looking for a senior Product Manager / Product Owner to lead Sygnum’s Core Banking Switzerland capabilities end-to-end. The role requires someone who can manage architectural and organisational complexity across the tri-party setup with Sygnum, Swisscom, and Finnova, while focusing the team’s efforts on the work that creates the biggest impact for the bank. The scope covers Sygnum’s Core Banking Services Platform, including internal integration applications, the Swisscom Managed Finance ecosystem (MFE), and the Finnova integration landscape, including SIL, FIL, ODS, and related services. You will act as the accountable interface across business, operations, compliance, technology, Release Management, and external vendors, ensuring priorities are clear and delivery remains controlled. Your main responsibilities
• Drive Core Banking Switzerland end-to-end, from discovery and roadmap definition through delivery, launch, and ongoing operations (change & run)
• Translate business, operational, regulatory, and vendor needs into a clear, outcome-driven backlog with explicit priorities, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria
• Provide subject matter expertise on core banking processes, integrations, and architectural dependencies
• Lead Swisscom and Finnova change requests, including analysis, scope definition, impact assessment, and commercial alignment
• Manage vendor governance for Swisscom and Finnova, including SLA oversight, dependency management, delivery follow-up, and escalations
• Coordinate incident and problem resolution with Swisscom (or Finnova where needed), including root-cause follow-up and continuous improvement
• Partner with technology and architecture teams on integration patterns, data flows, resilience, security, performance, and other non-functional requirements
• Work with Release Management and relevant owners to plan and release changes safely across the tri-party setup
• Support budget planning and financial monitoring for Swisscom and Finnova-related services, changes, and dependencies
• Run the agile delivery setup, including backlog ownership, sprint prioritisation, PI preparation where relevant, and collaboration through Jira and Confluence You are a senior Product Manager with strong core banking experience and the ability to combine product leadership, vendor governance, and hands-on delivery discipline in a regulated environment. You can structure ambiguity, manage senior stakeholders, and turn complexity into clear priorities, reliable delivery, and stable operations. You bring:
• 7+ years of experience in product management or product ownership for core banking, banking platforms, payments, ledger, reconciliation, or similar regulated financial services environments
• Strong understanding of core banking capabilities and operating models, including accounts, payments, ledger, reconciliation, integrations, and operational controls
• Experience with Finnova or a comparable core banking vendor ecosystem. Direct Finnova exposure is an advantage
• Proven ability to define strategy and roadmaps, prioritise based on outcomes and trade-offs, and drive delivery to completion
• Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, including scope definition, SLA oversight, commercial discussions, and dependency management
• Strong analytical skills to structure requirements into decision material, delivery plans, and a high-quality backlog
• High ownership mindset across change and run, including incident triage, root-cause follow-up, operational stability, and continuous improvement
• Effective written and verbal communication in English and German, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders and external vendors
• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, information systems, or equivalent practical experience Nice to have
• Knowledge of Finnova Open Platform, SIL, FIL, ODS, or related Swiss core banking integration patterns
• Experience with Program Increments, value streams, or scaled agile delivery models in financial services
• API-first product experience and comfort collaborating with engineering on integrations, data flows, and non-functional requirements
• Experience scaling platform products in high-growth or regulated banking environments
• Interest in digital assets, tokenisation, and crypto-related banking products Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

jobs.description:
You will join our AI Hub within the CEO Office – the team driving the bank’s AI transformation - and help build AI-enabled solutions that create measurable impact across the organisation. Working side by side with experienced engineers and business stakeholders, you will design, build and ship AI-powered agents and tools that go into real production use: from productivity tooling and operational workflows to Client Lifecycle Management, back-office operations and run-the-bank processes. As AI agents reshape how clients interact with financial services, you will contribute to solutions that touch the client experience directly — supporting relationship managers with AI-augmented workflows, accelerating client onboarding and servicing, and helping shape how the bank engages with an emerging generation of AI-native clients. You will build on top of foundational models such as OpenAI and Anthropic Claude and learn how to turn AI ideas into secure, reliable and well-governed solutions in a regulated banking environment. You will work hands-on with emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and explore how AI agents connect with internal systems, APIs and data sources — and, increasingly, how banks expose their services to the agents of their clients. As a forward deployed engineer, you will sit close to the business: understanding real problems, prototyping quickly, and iterating with users until solutions deliver genuine value. Our ideal candidate
• Recent graduate or early-career engineer with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience
• Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, software design and structured problem-solving
• Solid programming skills in Python and/or Java, with the ability to learn additional languages, frameworks and tools as needed
• Experience in LLM-based applications, agentic workflows and practical AI use cases
• Careful engineering mindset, with a focus on clean code, testing, reliability, responsible data handling and user value
• Genuine interest in understanding business problems, with the drive to translate stakeholder needs into working solutions
• Clear communication style, with the ability to ask good questions and work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Internship, thesis, project or early professional experience in AI, machine learning, LLM applications or data-driven product development
• Hands-on exposure to LLM APIs, building agentic workflows, using MCP or similar tools
• Exposure to APIs, microservices, containerization, cloud platforms or DevOps concepts
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar, and an understanding of how to use them responsibly
• Product thinking and a commercial mindset — an eye for where AI creates value for clients and the business, not just where it is technically interesting
• Interest in financial services, digital assets, regulated environments or secure software development Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. jobs.description:
We are looking for a Head of Operational Risk & Resilience to lead the second-line operational risk function of the world's first regulated digital asset bank. Reporting directly to the Chief Risk Officer, you will own our operational risk framework end-to-end — and drive the bank's operational resilience agenda under FINMA Circular 2023/1 across our custody, trading, tokenisation and banking businesses. This is a hands-on leadership role in a lean, high-calibre risk function: you will set the direction, lead a small team, and personally deliver the substance that makes independent challenge credible — towards the business, the Group Executive Board and FINMA. Key responsibilities: - Own and continuously develop the operational risk management framework: policy, RCSA methodology, incident and loss-data management, issue management, scenario analysis and integration with the bank's Risk Appetite Framework - Lead the operational resilience programme under FINMA Circular 2023/1: critical function mapping, impact tolerances, scenario testing and second-line oversight of business continuity management - Provide second-line oversight and challenge of outsourcing and third-party risk management in line with FINMA requirements, covering the bank's critical technology providers - Own operational risk reporting: design and produce KRIs, integrated risk reports and committee papers for the Group Executive Board, Board risk committee, and for the Regulators - Represent operational risk towards regulator, external and internal audit, including ownership of remediation items and regulatory submissions - Lead, develop and prioritise a small team, and coordinate operational risk matters across group entities - Drive the modernisation of the risk function's tooling, including AI-augmented approaches to reporting, KRI production and risk assessment documentation
• 8+ years of experience in operational or non-financial risk management within a regulated bank or financial institution, including several years in a leadership or senior second-line role; Swiss regulatory environment strongly preferred
• Deep working knowledge of FINMA Circular 2023/1 (operational risks and resilience) and Swiss outsourcing requirements, with a track record of building or substantially uplifting an operational risk or resilience framework
• A hands-on “player-coach” profile: comfortable owning methodology and committee papers personally in a lean team, not only directing others
• Strong technology affinity and genuine interest in digital assets: able to engage credibly on custody infrastructure, key management, cloud and 24/7 market operations — crypto-curious, with banking discipline

jobs.description:
Are you a people person? Do you have a strong interest in business development and sales? Do you want to build and maintain trusted client relationships in the digital asset space and help transform the future of finance? If this sounds like you, we have the perfect role for you. Role scope: Enable the B2B (Bank-to-Bank) team to retain and broader its leadership in digital assets by giving the world's largest banks regulated access to digital assets. Wear three hats simultaneously across the full lifecycle of the client relationship — acquisition, integration and growth – leveraging competencies in key account/relationship management, project management and product development. Drive growth by helping lead the team's expansion across markets, product categories and use cases, adapting to competitive pressure and market change. Business development & acquisition:
• Drive business development and pipeline management, sourcing and acquiring new banking partners across international markets – with a focus on our existing licensing footprint (Switzerland, Europe) and opportunities in new, untapped markets – including a dedicated bridge into Middle East and Asia to coordinate acquisition efforts with local teams.
• Drive sales activity along the full acquisition funnel: strategic networking and industry engagement, pitching, RFI/RFP responses, deep dives, and commercial/legal discussions.
• Contribute to strategic projects related to internationalisation and acquisition strategy, including scoping the Target Operating Model (TOM) based on licensing, client stickiness and upselling opportunities. Client & relationship management:
• Lead the end-to-end client journey – from initial contact and onboarding (working closely with Legal & Compliance, Operations and external partners) through to ongoing account management and daily operational support (fiat/digital asset transactions, trading orders, loans, contract amendments, complaint resolution).
• Provide RM support with flexible resource allocation across the client base, progressively learning to cover all stages of the customer lifecycle alongside our Relationship Managers.
• Grow the client business by expanding our digital asset offering (e.g. new tokens, DeFi products, Crypto Compliance Services) and designing bespoke proposals in collaboration with teams such as Asset Management and Trading. Product & internal collaboration:
• Interact with topic experts and Project/Product Managers to support and productize institutional requirements (e.g. API connectivity, institutional DLT services) and drive integration and product development for banking partners.
• Maintain, update and improve internal tools (Core Banking System, ticketing platform, CRM) to ensure efficient operations and accurate record-keeping. Market expertise & network:
• Stay at the forefront of the crypto market and broader DLT landscape – deeply understanding Sygnum's offering and competitive strengths, regulatory developments and digital asset trends – while building and maintaining a strong institutional and professional network through conferences and industry engagement.
• Partner with partner banks and ecosystem providers to create a world-class offering for banking clients while acting as the sole counterparty for our clients.
• Represent Sygnum at industry/ecosystem events to drive Sales, Business Developments and to engage in thought leadership with senior peers, stakeholders and future clients.
• BSc/BA in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. MSc/MBA/CFA is a plus.
• 5+ years of proven experience in client servicing or relationship management with private and/or institutional clients.
• Solid understanding of digital assets and DLT and the institutional crypto landscape (custody, trading, staking, tokenization), combined with working knowledge of the relevant regulatory frameworks (MiCAR, the Swiss DLT Act and FINMA/EU regimes)
• Proven track record of Product Management / Project Management career experience and competences within high-tech industries
• Demonstrable credentials of driving business growth with a hunter mentality, combining a strong sales mindset with a results-oriented approach to winning and expanding client relationships.
• An established network across banks, financial intermediaries and the broader financial ecosystem, with a demonstrated ability to open doors and convert relationships into commercial opportunities.
• Hands-on experience with client onboarding (both private individuals and legal entities), including a strong understanding of European banking regulations and the AMLD compliance framework.
• Combination of consultative and analytical skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a proactive, hands-on approach.
• Ability to work independently and effectively collaborate with cross-location teams.
• Excellent communication skills (spoken and written) in English. German language is a plus.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation abilities to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
• Valid Swiss/EU work authorisation and availability to work on-site at least 3 days per week is a must. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

Vuoi costruire e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti affidabili nello spazio asset digitale e contribuire a trasformare il futuro della finanza? Se questo suona come te, abbiamo il ruolo perfetto per te. Scopo del ruolo: Abilitare il team B2B (Bank-to-Bank) di mantenere e ampliare la sua leadership nei beni digitali dando alle banche più grandi del mondo l'accesso regolamentato ai beni digitali. Indossare tre cappelli simultaneamente attraverso il ciclo di vita completo del rapporto cliente — acquisizione, integrazione e crescita – sfruttando le competenze in chiave di gestione account / reportship, gestione del progetto e sviluppo del prodotto. Sviluppo aziendale e acquisizione:
• Incoraggiare lo sviluppo aziendale e la gestione delle pipeline, sourcing e l'acquisizione di nuovi partner bancari in tutti i mercati internazionali – con un focus sulla nostra attuale impronta di licensing (Svizzera, Europa) e le opportunità nei nuovi mercati non sfruttati – tra cui un ponte dedicato in Medio Oriente e Asia per coordinare gli sforzi di acquisizione con i team locali.
• Attività di vendita di unità lungo l'imbuto di acquisizione completa: networking strategico e impegno del settore, pitching, risposte RFI/RFP, immersioni profonde e discussioni commerciali/legali.
• Contribuire a progetti strategici relativi alla strategia di internazionalizzazione e acquisizione, tra cui scoping the Target Operating Model (TOM) basato su licenze, appiccicosi e opportunità di upselling. Gestione clienti e relazioni:
• Condurre il viaggio cliente end-to-end – dal contatto iniziale e dall'imbarco (lavorando a stretto contatto con Legal & Compliance, Operazioni e partner esterni) attraverso la gestione del conto in corso e il supporto operativo quotidiano (cooperazione di asset fiat/digital, ordini di trading, prestiti, modifiche contrattuali, risoluzione dei reclami).
• Fornisci supporto RM con assegnazione flessibile delle risorse attraverso la base del cliente, imparando progressivamente a coprire tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita del cliente insieme ai nostri Relationship Manager.
• Crescere il business client espandendo la nostra offerta di asset digitali (ad esempio nuovi gettoni, prodotti DeFi, Crypto Compliance Services) e progettando proposte su misura in collaborazione con team come Asset Management e Trading. Prodotti e collaborazione interna:
• Interagire con esperti di argomento e Project/Product Manager per supportare e prodottizzare i requisiti istituzionali (ad esempio connettività API, servizi DLT istituzionali) e l'integrazione e lo sviluppo dei prodotti per i partner bancari.
• Mantenere, aggiornare e migliorare gli strumenti interni (Core Banking System, piattaforma di ticketing, CRM) per garantire operazioni efficienti e registrazione accurata. Competenze di mercato e rete:
• Soggiorna all'avanguardia del mercato cripto e del panorama DLT più ampio – profondamente comprensivo dell'offerta di Sygnum e dei punti di forza competitivi, degli sviluppi normativi e delle tendenze degli asset digitali – costruendo e mantenendo una forte rete istituzionale e professionale attraverso conferenze e impegno del settore.
• Partner con banche partner e fornitori di ecosistemi per creare un'offerta di livello mondiale per i clienti bancari, agendo come unica controparte per i nostri clienti.
• Rappresentare Sygnum negli eventi del settore/ecosistema per guidare le vendite, gli sviluppi aziendali e impegnarsi nella leadership di pensiero con colleghi senior, stakeholder e clienti futuri.
• BSc/BA in Business Administration, finanza o un campo correlato. MSc/MBA/CFA è un plus.
• 5+ anni di comprovata esperienza nel servizio clienti o nella gestione delle relazioni con clienti privati e/o istituzionali.
• Solida comprensione dei beni digitali e del DLT e del panorama crittografico istituzionale (custodia, trading, staking, tokenization), combinato con la conoscenza operativa dei relativi quadri normativi (MiCAR, Swiss DLT Act e FINMA/EU regimi)
• Provato record di Product Management / Project Management esperienza di carriera e competenze all'interno di industrie high-tech
• Le credenziali dimostrabili di guidare la crescita aziendale con una mentalità cacciatrice, combinando una forte mentalità di vendita con un approccio orientato ai risultati per vincere e espandere le relazioni con i clienti.
• Una rete consolidata tra banche, intermediari finanziari e l'ecosistema finanziario più ampio, con una capacità dimostrata di aprire le porte e convertire le relazioni in opportunità commerciali.
• Esperienza pratica con il cliente a bordo (sia privati che enti legali), compresa una forte comprensione delle normative bancarie europee e del quadro di conformità AMLD.
• Combinazione di competenze consultive e analitiche, con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio proattivo e pratico.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed efficace collaborare con i team di cross-location.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione (spoken e scritto) in inglese. La lingua tedesca è un vantaggio.
• Eccellenti capacità organizzative e di priorità per gestire contemporaneamente più clienti e progetti.
• L'autorizzazione al lavoro svizzera/UE valida e la disponibilità a lavorare in loco almeno 3 giorni a settimana sono indispensabili. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day, e regolarmente celebrare insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:
• Combinazione attraente di salari di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale
• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy
• Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

• Contribuer aux projets stratégiques liés à la stratégie d'internationalisation et d'acquisition, y compris la détermination de la portée du modèle d'exploitation cible (TOM) en fonction des licences, de l'adhérence des clients et des possibilités de vente. Gestion client & relation :

• Développez l'activité client en élargissant notre offre d'actifs numériques (p. ex. nouveaux jetons, produits DeFi, Crypto Compliance Services) et en concevant des propositions sur mesure en collaboration avec des équipes comme Asset Management et Trading. Produit et collaboration interne :

jobs.description:
At the Portal team, we’re the heart of Sygnum’s client-facing experience, and our work directly impacts how users interact with their digital assets. Our mission is to create state-of-the-art UI/UX solutions that not only meet but exceed client expectations, keeping their needs at the center of everything we do. We collaborate closely with Custody, Trading, Tokenization, and Banking Operations teams to ensure our applications are robust, secure, and cutting-edge. But we’re more than just colleagues, we’re a vibrant community that values creativity, innovation, and fun. We believe a supportive and enjoyable work environment fosters collaboration, trust, and proactive problem-solving. Continuous improvement is in our DNA; we rely on data-driven insights to refine our approaches and deliver excellence. Joining us means being part of a team that’s as committed to quality and user experience as it is to create a workplace you’ll love coming to every day. As a tech lead, you are comfortable wearing two hats: tech and management. From a technical perspective, you will:
• Lead a team of software engineers to develop and own state-of-the-art solutions (front and back end).
• Constantly enhance quality and security of the applications.
• Collaborate with Design to improve our client centric products.
• Contribute to writing and reviewing high quality and secured code covered by tests.
• Work with SRE engineers and solution architects to improve the availability, resilience, and observability of the applications. From a managerial perspective, you will:
• Coach and mentor software engineers in the team.
• Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
• Partner with product managers and stakeholders to plan new features and improvements.
• Drive blameless retros and post-mortems that help the team learn from mistakes.
• Promote a psychologically safe space where everyone feels they can contribute and improve things.
• Fluency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Nestjs.
• Designing reusable and extendable components for multiple projects.
• Experience and references as a Frontend Engineer in complex setups.
• Understanding UI & UX to seek the best experience for the user
• Knowledge about data preparation, API first and concept isolation
• Understanding the development lifecycle and its technologies – Git, CI/CD tools, unit testing, vulnerability.
• Expertise on agile frameworks (Scrum, kanban...).
• You are eager to work with FE and BE.
• You enjoy doing both: technical and people leadership work.
• You have a collaborative and growth mindset.
• You care about quality and security and bake those aspects in the software development lifecycle.
• You are comfortable taking ownership of the whole development lifecycle, from designing solutions to running the application in production.
• You are proactive and get motivated with new opportunities and challenges. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

• Gli ingegneri del software di coach e mentore nella squadra.
• Migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia del team.
• Partner con product manager e stakeholder per pianificare nuove funzionalità e miglioramenti.
• Guida retrò e post-mortem senza colpa che aiutano la squadra a imparare dagli errori.

• Progettazione di componenti riutilizzabili ed estensibili per più progetti.
• Esperienza e riferimenti come Ingegnere Frontend in configurazioni complesse.
• Comprendere UI & UX per cercare la migliore esperienza per l'utente
• Conoscenza della preparazione dei dati, prima API e isolamento dei concetti
• Comprendere il ciclo di vita di sviluppo e le sue tecnologie – Git, strumenti CI/CD, test di unità, vulnerabilità.
• Competenza sulle strutture agili (Scrum, kanban...).
• Sei impaziente di lavorare con FE e BE.
• Ti piace fare entrambi: lavoro di leadership tecnico e personale.
• Hai una mentalità collaborativa e di crescita.
• Ti importa di qualità e sicurezza e cuocere quegli aspetti nel ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software.
• Sei a tuo agio a prendere la proprietà di tutto il ciclo di vita di sviluppo, dalla progettazione di soluzioni per l'esecuzione dell'applicazione in produzione.
• Sei proattivo e motivati con nuove opportunità e sfide. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. • Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy

jobs.title: (Senior) Relationship Manager, Private Banking

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des relations, Services bancaires privés

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a (Senior) Relationship Manager in our Private Banking business with notable experience to develop Sygnum’s presence offices with focus on Private Banking offering. You will be reporting to the Head, Private Clients & Single-Family Offices.
• Take responsibility to source and foster new private clients and single family offices via an already active network within the industry.
• Oversee multiple prospects and prioritize efforts to anticipate and ensure appropriate responses to their needs. Provision of solution-oriented support for Private Banking over the phone, via e-mail and in physical meetings in the areas of onboarding, product-related questions, transactions, technical support, contract amendments, complaints, etc.
• Lead the client onboarding process together with internal stakeholders (Legal & Compliance Operations) and external service providers.
• Processing fiat and digital asset transactions as well as post transaction AML monitoring and processing.
• Update and maintain the CRM for accurate recordkeeping of all relationships.
• Maintain an expert level of understanding of the crypto market landscape by understanding Sygnum’s offering and strengths, attending conferences, understanding the regulatory developments, and building a strong institutional and professional prospect network.
• Further development of the customer care framework (user guides, tutorials, FAQs, etc).
• BSc/BA in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. MSc/MBA/CFA is a plus.
• 5+ years of proven experience in client servicing or relationship management within a (Swiss) financial institution focused on the Private Banking segment.
• Track record of driving business growth with a hunter mentality, combining a strong sales mindset with a results-oriented approach to winning and expanding client relationships.
• Hands-on experience with client onboarding (both private individuals and legal entities), including a strong understanding of the Swiss banking regulations including familiarity with KYC processes and AML/CTF requirements.
• Combination of consultative and analytical skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a proactive, hands-on approach.
• Ability to work independently and effectively collaborating with cross—location teams.
• Excellent communication skills (spoken and written) in French and English. German language is a plus.
• Excellent organizational and prioritization abilities to manage multiple clients and project simultaneously. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Assumere la responsabilità di fonte e promuovere nuovi clienti privati e singoli uffici familiari tramite una rete già attiva all'interno del settore.
• Superare più prospettive e privilegiare gli sforzi per anticipare e garantire risposte adeguate alle loro esigenze. Fornitura di un sostegno orientato alla soluzione per Private Banking al telefono, via e-mail e nelle riunioni fisiche nei settori dell'imbarco, delle domande relative ai prodotti, delle transazioni, del supporto tecnico, degli emendamenti contrattuali, dei reclami, ecc.
• Guidare il processo di onboarding del cliente insieme a parti interessate interne (Operazioni legali e di conformità) e fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Elaborazione di operazioni di fiat e di asset digitali, nonché monitoraggio e elaborazione delle transazioni AML post transazione.
• Aggiornare e mantenere il CRM per la registrazione accurata di tutte le relazioni.
• Mantenere un livello esperto di comprensione del panorama del mercato crittografico comprendendo l'offerta e i punti di forza di Sygnum, partecipare a conferenze, comprendere gli sviluppi normativi, e la costruzione di una forte rete di prospettiva istituzionale e professionale.
• Ulteriore sviluppo del framework di assistenza clienti (guida utente, tutorial, FAQ, ecc).
• BSc/BA in Business Administration, finanza o un campo correlato. MSc/MBA/CFA è un plus.
• 5+ anni di comprovata esperienza nel servizio clienti o nella gestione delle relazioni all'interno di un istituto finanziario (Swiss) focalizzato sul segmento Private Banking.
• Tracciare il record di crescita aziendale di guida con una mentalità di cacciatore, combinando una forte mentalità di vendita con un approccio orientato ai risultati per vincere e espandere le relazioni dei clienti.
• Esperienza pratica con i clienti di bordo (sia privati che enti legali), compresa una forte comprensione delle normative bancarie svizzere, tra cui la familiarità con i processi KYC e i requisiti AML/CTF.
• Combinazione di competenze consultive e analitiche, con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio proattivo e pratico.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed efficace collaborando con i team di cross-location.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione (spoken e scritto) in francese e inglese. La lingua tedesca è un vantaggio.
• Eccellenti capacità organizzative e di priorità per gestire più clienti e progetti contemporaneamente. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day, e regolarmente celebrare insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:
• Combinazione attraente di salari di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale
• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy
• Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di occupazione continua Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

• Review and harden Infrastructure-as-Code implementations to enable secure cloud deployment patterns and reusable guardrails.

• Partner with SOC and engineering teams to improve detection, alerting, and response capabilities for application-layer threats. You are an experienced technical security expert who can demonstrate the following skills and experience:
• 5-7+ years of deep, hands-on experience in application security or DevSecOps in modern engineering environments .
• Strong experience securing cloud-native architectures (AWS and Azure preferred ) .

jobs.description:
As an Investor Relations Intern, you will collaborate closely with both the Investor Relations team and the CEO Office, gaining hands-on experience in fundraising, strategic decision-making, and corporate development. Working closely with experienced professionals, you will gain hands-on exposure to venture fundraising, capital markets and corporate strategy in a fast-growing digital asset bank. This internship offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects, contributing to investor communications, operational excellence, and broader corporate initiatives. Responsibilities
• Drive strategic initiatives: Take ownership of specific projects and initiatives, ensuring smooth execution and tangible impact.
• Investor reporting & communication: Prepare and manage quarterly reports and investor updates, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
• Fundraising & investor relations support: Assist in creating fundraising and investor relations presentations, participate in investor meetings, and manage follow-ups.
• Market research & due diligence: Conduct in-depth market research and support due diligence efforts related to investment opportunities and strategic partnerships.
• IPO & M&A support: Contribute to IPO and M&A-related processes, including research, documentation, and coordination with investment banks and other third parties.
• Strategic projects: Work on key initiatives led by the CEO Office, such as international expansion, process improvements, and corporate strategy development.
• AI & process innovation: Help design and implement new AI agents and tools to automate and streamline key processes, with the objective of increasing efficiency and quality across Investor Relations and the wider CEO Office.
• You are currently completing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering or a related discipline
• You are an independent thinker who can execute tasks autonomously. We expect you to take the lead and drive things
• You are an open-minded team player. You will work in a position where many endpoints come together. It is vital that you can efficiently collaborate with other teams to further push our goals as a company
• A strong can-do attitude is essential. As a pioneer in the industry, your scope of action will be broad, and we expect you to be willing, and ideally enthusiastic, about tackling the challenges ahead. For some, you may already know the solution; for others, you will need to discover it
• We do not expect extensive prior experience in every topic. However, we expect you to quickly understand unfamiliar subjects and build expertise independently
• You have a genuine interest in digital assets and share our vision for the future of finance
• You use AI tools effectively and responsibly, verify outputs and recognise the importance of confidentiality and data protection
• You are proficient in PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly, visually and with attention to detail
• You communicate confidently and professionally, both verbally and in writing, in internal meetings and interactions with external partners
• You have a strong analytical mindset and can collect and analyse information, structure complex problems and develop practical solutions Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Opportunity to be part of a movement shaping the future of our world’s financial system
• Experienced leadership teams who are masters of scale and facilitate smart growth
• Colleagues that are friendly, diverse, professional, highly skilled, international, and motivated
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!
